page.overview:
What is Madam Malkin's Robes for All Occasions?

Madam Malkin's Robes for All Occasions, also known as Madam Malkin's Robes or simply Madam Malkin's, was a clothing shop in the wizarding world that operated from two branches: one in Diagon Alley in London, and another in Paris. Wizards and witches could purchase Hogwarts uniforms here, dress robes, travelling cloaks, and on very rare occasions, Invisibility Cloaks. Presumably, with a branch in Paris, Beauxbatons students were also served.

Harry Potter first visited the shop in 1991 after Rubeus Hagrid told him to get his uniform robes for Hogwarts. Hagrid was incapable of entering the shop due to his size so after recovering from sickness in the Gringotts Mine Carts, he bought two large ice creams for each of them. During his visit to the shop, Harry met Draco Malfoy for the first time.

In spring of 1992, Madam Malkin's was closed with a small notice on the door, which read "Gone to Paris for "Which Witch?" fashion show." During the 1992 Christmas holidays, the shop was closed again, with a notice reading "We are closed due to daylight robery - back at seven o'cloak" (An obvious pun on "robbery" and "clock").

Due to growing several more inches, Harry returned to Madam Malkin's to buy new uniform robes in 1993.
